justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/channels/ByteArraySeekableByteChannel.java (289 LOC), CloseShieldChannel.java (105 LOC), CloseShieldChannelHandler.java (161 LOC), FileChannels.java (172 LOC), and package-info.java. The package contains only 4 production classes plus package docs, about 750 LOC total, and each class has a narrow, cohesive responsibility (byte-array-backed SeekableByteChannel, close-shield proxy/handler, and file/channel content comparison helpers). There is no evidence of a large, multi-responsibility package or excessive centralization.
